patterns.note: A fixed top navigation bar overlays a vertically scrolling content area, maintaining persistent access to key sections.
Project content is presented in a dense, multi-column grid that expands vertically, maximizing the display of work samples.
The hero section features extremely large, single-line text elements that break across the viewport width, creating a dominant visual statement.
A stark black-on-white color scheme dominates the typography and background, with project images providing the only bursts of color.
A subtle, transparent ASCII art or text pattern is fixed in the background, with page content scrolling over it, creating a layered depth effect.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is positioned to stick to the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility as the user scrolls.
The hero section uses oversized typography that spans the width of the screen, creating a bold, immediate statement.
Project entries are arranged in a responsive grid layout, allowing for a high density of content while maintaining visual order.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized hero text (~8-10x body text) with standard-sized body and navigation text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero, transitioning to a dense, tightly packed grid for project displays.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an extremely large, almost abstract hero text combined with a subtle, fixed ASCII art background layer creates a unique blend of minimalist boldness and hidden complexity, setting it apart from typical portfolio sites.
